Be part of our team!

 

AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. AT&S industrializes leading-edge technologies for its core business segments Mobile Devices & Substrates, Automotive & Aerospace, Industrial and Medical and high-performance computing for AI applications. We are looking for talent eager to shape the future of our interconnected world. With plants in Austria, China, India, Malaysia and sales offices around the globe, we offer excellent career opportunities for creators, innovators and enablers with the drive to make a difference. To enhance our successful Controlling Team at the Headquarters in Leoben, Austria, we are looking for a passionate 1 Head of Controlling (m/w/d) In your role, you will drive effective cross-functional collaboration and provide reliable financial leadership by overseeing reporting, forecasting, compliance, strategic planning, cost initiatives, government grant processes, and lead the Controlling Team. 

Your Responsibilities 

 * Lead and develop the Controlling Team, fostering a positive culture and high-performance mindset

 * Drive budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes to enable informed business decisions

 * Partner closely with Operations, Sales, Purchasing, and other business functions to support business objectives

 * Identify opportunities to improve profitability, optimize costs, and enhance overall business performance

 * Provide meaningful financial insights and recommendations to support management decision-making

 * Support strategic projects through business case evaluations, ROI simulations, and investment analyses

 * Oversee OPEX and CAPEX performance while promoting continuous improvement across controlling activities 

Your Profile 

 * Relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

 * Experience in Operations Controlling, ideally within a manufacturing environment

 * Solid leadership experience with the ability to develop, motivate, and inspire teams

 * Strong expertise in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management

 * Advanced SAP (FI/CO, BW, BPC) knowledge

 * Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate financial data into business insights and recommendations

 * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 * Business-oriented approach with a strong understanding of operational processes

 * Strong ownership mentality with a proactive and results-driven approach

 * Fluent in German and English 

Our Offer 

 * A meaningful role with opportunities for long-term growth in an international environment 

 * Chance to actively contribute to AT&S' success and to create value 

 * A structured and tailor-made onboarding program along with continual training opportunities

 * Modern company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day

 * Free parking spaces and e-charging stations

 * Diverse health measures and a wide range of employee benefits 

Ready for a new challenge to advance your career? It's just a click to apply online. We look forward to your application and your detailed resume. Your AT&S Team!

 https://career.ats.net/job/Leoben-Head-of-Controlling/1445129333/

AT&S is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are dedicated to empowering people to reach their potential by fostering their unique talents and strengths. The employment is in accordance with the Austrian Collective Agreement for the Electrical and Electronics Industry, employment group H, and we offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. Senior Scientist - Ion-trap chips (all genders)

We are looking for an experienced scientist leading the development of ion-traps and their applications at SAL. You will become part of a highly motivated, international team committed to building up a European pilot line for ion-trap chips (ITCs) realizing the building blocks of next generation quantum technology. Your work will be embedded in an international collaborative network. 

Your future tasks include:

 * Establishment of infrastructure and set-ups for testing and operation of ion trap devices and development of ion trap systems for Quantum technology applications.

 * Coordination and alignment of internal efforts and activities with industrial and academic partners in the pilot line.

 * Contribution to design, simulation and characterization of new ion trap chips.

 * Dissemination, communication and reporting of research findings to both scientific and non-scientific audiences.

 * Supervision of students.

 * Activities in relevant networks. 

 * Project management.

 * Project and funding acquisition.

Your profile:

jobs.description:
1 Technical Operator  Plant Operations & Maintenance (m/f/d) to keep our carbonation plant running day to day. You'll make sure the plant runs reliably, the material is prepared correctly and our trials are carried out cleanly. Because nobody is closer to the plant than you, you'll also become an important voice when it comes to developing it further.

We're headquartered in Vienna, with two additional technical sites in Vienna and Upper Austria; this position is based at our site in 4800 Attnang-Puchheim. Join an ambitious team and help take CO2 mineralization from pilot to industrial scale.

Key Responsibilities

Plant Operations

¿ Operate the carbonation plant according to operating instructions, including start-up and shutdown

¿ Monitor process parameters (pressure, temperature, CO2 supply, throughput) and respond to deviations following defined procedures

¿ Carry out test series together with our science team

¿ Take material and product samples according to the sampling plan

Material Preparation & Logistics

¿ Receive and store raw materials (industrial mineral residues)

¿ Prepare material as specified (e.g. screening, mixing, moistening, dosing) and feed it into the plant

¿ Move material with pallet truck and crane, optionally also with a forklift

Maintenance & Servicing

¿ Carry out inspections and maintenance according to the maintenance plan

¿ Dismantle and clean the plant and its components

¿ Replace wear parts and fix simple mechanical and electrical faults

¿ Support our engineers and external partners with modifications, extensions and the installation of new components (sensors, wiring, drives)

Documentation & Safety

¿ Keep operating and maintenance logs

¿ Jointly develop work and maintenance plans as well as instructions

¿ Ensure occupational safety, cleanliness and order at the plant and in the warehouse

¿ Bring in improvement ideas from day-to-day operations

Skills & Qualifications

¿ Motivation beats qualifications - if you like to get hands-on, think along and enjoy learning new things, we'll teach you the rest

¿ Completed technical college (HTL, ideally electrical engineering, mechatronics, mechanical or process engineering) or a technical apprenticeship; career changers with good manual skills are welcome too

¿ Experience in electrical work, assembly, installation or operating production plants is a clear advantage - we value commitment and reliability over years on the clock

¿ You can read circuit diagrams and technical drawings and find your way around controls (PLC/HMI) - or want to learn

¿ Careful, reliable and safety-conscious; you're happy to do physical work

¿ Nice to have: welding skills, English, crane licence, forklift licence (optional), qualified electrician certification, experience with bulk materials or pressure vessels

¿ Driving licence B, German skills (B2) and willingness to work occasional overtime

Why Join Us?

¿ Take on real ownership of "your" plant from day one and help shape how it runs and improves

¿ Work closely with a high-performing team of engineers and scientists in a fast-moving startup environment

¿ Variety between plant, workshop and office - no two days are the same

¿ Targeted training, e.g. crane and forklift licences, electrical and control engineering

¿ Grow with us: as we move to industrial scale, your responsibilities grow too

¿ Full-time position incl. workwear and personal protective equipment

¿ Fair salary: minimum € 2.173,58 gross per month (paid 14 times a year) under the collective agreement, with overpayment depending on qualifications and experience

¿ Earn a real stake in what you help build, through our employee participation programme

Interested? Send your CV and relevant certificates to
